_note: Programme names, labs and research areas are drafted placeholders for the department to verify. Intake and faculty counts stay as XX until official figures are supplied.

departments.name: Computer Science & Engineering
departments.summary: Computing, software engineering, artificial intelligence and emerging technologies.
departments.about: The department teaches the foundations of computing — algorithms, systems, data and software design — and builds on them with hands-on work in artificial intelligence, data science and cloud technologies.
departments.vision: To produce computer science engineers who solve real problems with sound fundamentals and responsible use of technology.
mission: Teach core computing with a strong problem-solving focus.
Give every student lab and project experience on current platforms.
Work with industry on internships, projects and training.
Encourage research, innovation and ethical practice.

departments.name: Civil Engineering
departments.summary: Structures, surveying, transportation, water resources and sustainable infrastructure.
departments.about: Civil Engineering prepares students to plan, design and build the infrastructure communities depend on — from buildings and roads to water systems — with an emphasis on safety and sustainability.
departments.vision: To develop civil engineers who build safe, sustainable infrastructure for society.
mission: Teach design and analysis grounded in field practice.
Expose students to site work, surveying and testing.
Promote sustainable and safe construction practice.
Partner with industry and government on projects.

departments.name: Electronics & Communication Engineering
departments.summary: Electronic devices, embedded systems, VLSI, signal processing and communication networks.
departments.about: ECE covers how electronic systems are designed and how they communicate — from devices and circuits to embedded systems, VLSI design and wireless networks.
departments.vision: To develop electronics and communication engineers ready for a connected world.
mission: Teach circuits, signals and systems with strong lab practice.
Build skills in embedded systems and VLSI design.
Engage students in projects with industry relevance.
Foster research and continuous learning.

departments.name: Electrical & Electronics Engineering
departments.summary: Power systems, electrical machines, control systems and renewable energy.
departments.about: EEE deals with how electrical energy is generated, transmitted, controlled and used — with growing focus on power electronics, electric mobility and renewable sources.
departments.vision: To develop electrical engineers who power a sustainable future.
mission: Teach machines, power systems and control with depth.
Provide practical exposure through labs and industrial visits.
Promote work in renewable energy and electric mobility.
Encourage innovation and professional ethics.

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments.summary: Design, manufacturing, thermal engineering, robotics and automation.
departments.about: Mechanical Engineering covers how machines are designed, analysed and made — thermal and fluid systems, manufacturing processes, and increasingly robotics and automation.
departments.vision: To develop mechanical engineers who design and make things that work.
mission: Teach design, thermal and manufacturing fundamentals.
Give hands-on experience in workshops and labs.
Introduce CAD/CAM, automation and robotics.
Connect students with manufacturing industry.
